name: Yuuki Hayato
source:
[url=/c1089]Shinobu[/url]'s classmate and friend since elementary school. His looks are quite good, so girls confess to him often, but he turns each of them down within a single week. Shinobu is not as popular with girls as Hayato, so he teaches Shinobu how to pick up girls.
